# fcx

> Run your own Farcaster read node and client in three commands. No API keys. An AI agent can do the setup by following agent.md; the person signs in themselves.

- [agent.md](https://antonpecherkin.github.io/fcx-cli/agent.md): step-by-step runbook for AI agents, with every status phase and error
- [Tutorial](https://antonpecherkin.github.io/fcx-cli/tutorial.html): FIDs, custody, app keys, read nodes and validators, storage
- [Renting the server](https://antonpecherkin.github.io/fcx-cli/server.html): Hetzner (scripted), Vultr, your own box
- [Source (MIT)](https://github.com/AntonPecherkin/fcx-cli)
